item.text: {"text":"{\"status\":\"NEEDS_IMPROVEMENT\",\"core_findings\":[\"Electronics has the weakest sampled training separation: 10.88% of negatives outrank positives, and its 10th-percentile margin is -0.0915. Movies_and_TV separates most strongly, with only 1.74% ranking reversals; the other datasets fall between these extremes.\",\"Embedding alignment scores of 0.5402–0.5842 indicate mildly positive mean cosine similarity, not established embedding collapse.\"],\"key_implications\":[\"Sampled training discrimination is uneven across datasets, with Electronics showing the largest share of confusing positions.\",\"These training margins and score scales do not establish validation HR@10 or full-catalog recommendation quality.\"],\"evidence\":{\"headline_metrics\":{\"Electronics:pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate\":0.1088,\"Electronics:pos_neg_margin_p10\":-0.0915,\"Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate\":0.0174,\"Electronics:embedding_collapse_score\":0.5842},\"brief_metric_read\":{\"Electronics:pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate\":\"Highest sampled ranking-reversal rate.\",\"Electronics:pos_neg_margin_p10\":\"Lower-tail margins cross below zero.\",\"Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate\":\"Lowest sampled ranking-reversal rate.\",\"Electronics:embedding_collapse_score\":\"Highest directional alignment; insufficient to establish collapse.\"}}}"}
